description_en: A wide trapezoidal woven travel bag with leather base, expandable textile zipper gusset and twin handles. Canonical front: a broad trapezoidal face crossed by two handle straps. Side view: a folded expansion gusset above the leather base. Rear view: a woven back panel with a trolley-handle sleeve. All panels, linings, hardware and inserts are completely unmarked; no text, logos, symbols or labels. Keep the identical structure, materials and attachments across all three views.
